page.overview:
Who is First Witch?

Described by Banquo as like a woman with a beard. They are also stated to have skinny lips and chapped fingers.

Cryptic at best, Scheming at worst, the first witch seems the most dominant, speaking first always the only one to address Hecate directly.

Witches have had a long presence in European history, with a sort of proto-witch being seen in the old testament but in England the ideas of witchcraft began properly during the reign of Henry VIII and James I who was a patron of Shakespeare's wrote a famous book on the subject.

Three is also seen as a magical number and represents ambition and ritualism. Hecate is also represented in classical Greek statues as being triplicate.
